notes: Mr_Meat31 (offlane) was alive but losing lane and pinned — with them stuck across the map, this was the wrong fight to start.
🎮 private (carry) was alive but losing lane and pinned — with them stuck across the map, this was the wrong fight to start.
We opened it a 1-body down (4v5) — the numbers were lost before the fight was.
Mr_Meat31 (offlane) was dead — went down 27s earlier, so this was never a full-strength fight.
Goldilocks324 (jungle) was alive and ahead in lane — a shove-and-rotate there flips a 2-1 into a numbers advantage.

draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Goldilocks324 (jungle→midlane).

coaching.headline: Eight won fights and seven of them cashed into objectives — the conversion this squad usually leaks was the entire win, 63,457 objective damage to their 1,724.
coaching.team: Two lanes read against us and it did not matter because the fights were picked right: the 3-1 at our outer tower at 10.5 cashed into Fangtooth at 12 and Mini Prime at 14, and the 19.2 3-1 restarted the engine every time they twitched. The one slip was the 17.6 fight at our Fangtooth, taken while the offlane and carry were both pinned in losing lanes — it cost an outer tower and the 18-minute Genesis Core, their only converted win, and it still only bought them three towers all game.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 10.5 teamfight at our outer tower set the pattern — win the fight, immediately cash the prize — and by minute 27 that pattern had banked three Fangtooths, Mini Prime, Genesis Core and Orb Prime.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Legion beat the 'theirs all game' offlane read outright — Aurora died to him four times — and added 20,756 objective damage on top of a 6/3 line. The two late deaths at 21.2 and 23.9 each preceded a lost outer tower; that is the only tax on an otherwise won lane.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 played the cleanest tank game on file: 0/1/12 on Rampage with 30,421 healing, 58,391 mitigated and 26,100 objective damage, winning the jungle read wire to wire. The lone footnote is 24.4, where he stayed ahead in lane while the team won a 4v5 without him — right result, risky habit.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Sparrow won an unfavored lane on aggression — Murdock died to him four times, and the solo 2-0s at 16.2 and 25.7 kept the pressure on while the map was being cashed. 9/3/3 into a lane read 'theirs all game' is the draft being beaten by the player.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim opened the scoring with first blood on Zinx at 6.2 and finished 5/1/10 with 40,779 mitigated — the frontline that made Sparrow's and Renna's kill totals possible. The build wandered off the Xenia-Dynamo core and it never mattered; the peel did the job.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Renna beat Argus four times in the mid matchup and added kills on Murdock and Zinx for a 7/5 line. The five deaths are the drill — the solo catches at 15.4 and 22.1 stand out, and the falls at 17.9, 22.1 and 24.4 each preceded a lost outer tower; a zone mage trades range for life when she wanders alone.

synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
ourKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
ourKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
ourKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar
